title: Book Of Crystals
description: This mod adds a book of crystals and four crystals. Each crystal has its own unique ability. A new effect will also be added - Infection, which deals damage over time.
body:
This mod adds a book of crystals and four crystals. Each crystal has its own unique ability.
Also, a new effect will be added - Infection, which deals periodic damage.

Textures made by - Kopay
Mod made by - Brenllyy

List of crystals


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

1. Crystal of Souls - stuns on impact and when you press the right mouse button, transfers the player to the spectator for three seconds.

2. Crystal of Demons - when you press the right mouse button, creates a ring of fire and imposes fire resistance.

3. Crystal of the Seas - when you press the right mouse button, creates waves around the player. There is a chance to turn the enemy into cod when hitting.

4. Crystal of the Void - when you press the right mouse button, creates a fireball and when you hit, imposes infection.

</details>
